tools.name: check_ghg_inventory_obligation
tools.description: Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Thresholds: 3,000 tCO2e, 1,000 TOE or 65,000 t of waste per year.

tools.name: get_ghg_regulations
tools.description: Key verified facts for Vietnam GHG compliance in 2026: Decision 42/2026 facility list (2,441 facilities), reporting deadline 31/3/2027, pilot ETS allowances (Decision 263), EU CBAM 2027 dates. Each item links to an EcoCheck explainer.

tools.name: cbam_scope_check
tools.description: EU CBAM: is a product (CN code) in scope, which aggregated goods category, are indirect emissions counted, and its EU default value for the country of production. Use the 8-digit CN code of the customs declaration (4/6 digits give a partial answer).

tools.name: cbam_default_value
tools.description: EU CBAM default value (tCO2e per tonne) of a CN8 code for a country of production, from Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by 2026/1740, with the mark-up of the import year (10 % 2026, 20 % 2027, 30 % from 2028; fertilisers 1 %). When the exact code has no row, returns candidate cod

tools.name: estimate_cbam_cost
tools.description: Indicative CBAM certificate cost for the EU importer: embedded emissions (default value with mark-up, or the producer's actual SEE) minus the free-allocation adjustment (Reg 2025/2620 benchmark × CBAM factor 97.5 % in 2026 × CSCF), times the official certificate price (latest quarterly price unless

tools.name: calculate_ghg_inventory
tools.description: GHG inventory from activity data, reported by ISO 14064-1 category (1-6), GHG Protocol scope and gas: fuels (IPCC 2006 tier-1 defaults; litres, kg, t, GJ, MWh…; stationary or mobile), purchased electricity (give the official grid factor of the year — no default built in), refrigerant / SF6 recharges

tools.name: ghg_emission_factors
tools.description: Built-in default factors used by calculate_ghg_inventory: fuels (NCV, CO2/CH4/N2O, density), refrigerant GWPs (AR5 / AR6), GWP sets. Cite them in the report.

tools.name: iso14064_guide
tools.description: Practical guidance for an ISO 14064-1 organization inventory (paraphrased, not the standard text): categories and boundaries with the Scope 1/2/3 cross-walk, significance of indirect emissions, quantification, base year and recalculation, uncertainty, report content and review checklist, ISO 14064-3

tools.name: search_ecocheck
tools.description: Search EcoCheck services, regulations and Vietnamese articles on GHG inventory, Scope 1/2/3, CBAM, carbon credits and ESG. Returns ranked matches with URLs.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: EcoCheck software plans (Basic free, Pro 4,950,000 VND/month, Pro+ 10,950,000 VND/month, Advanced custom) and where to find inventory-service cost ranges.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List EcoCheck services: GHG inventory service, inventory software platform, CBAM reporting, ESG reporting, free obligation lookup tool, Academy.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List EcoCheck articles (Vietnamese), newest first, optionally filtered by keyword.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one EcoCheck article as Markdown by numeric id or slug (from list_articles / search_ecocheck).

tools.name: about_ecocheck
tools.description: What EcoCheck is (company, product, services) with links to its pricing page, case studies and contact page.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_ghg_inventory_obligation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Kiểm tra cơ sở có thuộc diện bắt buộc kiểm kê khí nhà kính không, theo ngưỡng 3.000 tCO2tđ / 1.000 TOE / 65.000 tấn chất thải" → after: "Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Thresholds: 3,000 tCO2e, 1,000 TOE or 65,000 t of waste per year."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
